episodeTitle.en: Behind the product: Duolingo streaks | Jackson Shuttleworth (Group PM, Retention Team)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品背后的故事：Duolingo的学习连胜 | 杰克逊·沙特尔沃斯（Group PM，留存团队）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jackson Shuttleworth is a Group PM at Duolingo, where he leads the retention team and the powerful streak feature. The streak feature, which gamifies consecutive days of learning, has been Duolingo’s most important and innovative growth lever and a key driver of their growth to a $14 billion business with almost 600 million users. In our conversation, we dive deep into the history and lessons of this feature: • The evolution of the streak feature
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰克逊·沙特尔沃斯是Duolingo的Group PM，负责领导留存团队和强大的学习连胜功能。学习连胜功能通过将连续学习天数游戏化，为Duolingo提供了最重要且最具创新性的增长杠杆，也是其发展至市值140亿美元、拥有近6亿用户的关键驱动力。我们的对话深入探讨了该功能的演变历程及经验教训：• 学习连胜功能的演变

title.en: Behind the product: Duolingo streaks | Jackson Shuttleworth (Group PM, Retention Team)
title.zh: 产品背后的故事：Duolingo的学习连胜 | 杰克逊·沙特尔沃斯（Group PM，留存团队）

summary.en: Jackson walks through the entire journey of Duolingo's streaks feature—the wins, the wrong turns, and the 600+ experiments his team has run on it over four years—showing why it became the company's biggest growth lever (9M+ users now hold year-plus streaks). He shares what they learned about human motivation, the copy-testing infrastructure that lets them experiment constantly, and the psychology of habit-forming design. It's a deep, single-feature case study in how one mechanic can create billions in value.
summary.zh: Jackson 完整复盘了 Duolingo “连续打卡”功能的历程——成功、走错的弯路，以及团队四年里在它身上跑过的 600 多次实验，说明了为何它成了公司最大的增长杠杆（如今 900 多万用户保持着一年以上的连续打卡）。他分享了关于人类动机的洞见、让他们能持续实验的文案测试基础设施，以及习惯养成设计背后的心理学。这是一期关于“一个机制如何创造数十亿美元价值”的、聚焦单一功能的深度案例研究。
